comingLast.roast: off 31 on 17 - gallant to the end, blue to the finish
the rescue mission: 7 points, 6 holes, no pressure at all
safe by 1 - unless Nicholson finds form, in which case, gulp
finished with a 1-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
the escape ladder has 1 rungs - grip well
a 1-point cushion over Nicholson - thin ice, heavy walker
the cushion is 2 - more of a coaster really
2 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
above Nicholson by 2 - the safety rope is more of a shoelace
sitting 2 above the drop zone - Nicholson would love the company
